posts.title: Ihlamur Pavilion
posts.caption:
Built for Sultan Abdülmecid between 1849 and 1855, Ihlamur consists of the Merasim and Maiyet pavilions. Their small scale contrasts with the major waterfront palaces, while elaborate stone decoration reflects nineteenth-century Ottoman taste for European-inspired ornament.
